title: 玻璃核心封裝基板
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入玻璃核心平整度、TGV 與脆裂風險；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine glass-core flatness, tgvs and brittle-fracture risk. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。公開測試載具展示不能等同所有玻璃核心方案已量產；材料組成、TGV 幾何與電性需個別驗證。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. A public test-vehicle demonstration does not establish production status for every glass-core solution; composition, TGV geometry and electrical behavior require validation.

stages.title: 玻璃核心角色
stages.description: 本階段處理玻璃核心角色：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address glass-core role through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 定義核心與增層
steps.titleEn: Define core and build-up
steps.objective: 建立「定義核心與增層」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：核心負責機械支撐及穿通，外側增層負責細密佈線。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define core and build-up: The core supports mechanics and through-connections; outer build-up handles fine routing.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。將核心和增層分色標示。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Color core and build-up separately. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：將核心和增層分色標示。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Color core and build-up separately. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：玻璃平整就不會產生裂紋。本步先檢查「定義核心與增層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到核心負責機械支撐及穿通，外側增層負責細密佈線。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Flat glass cannot crack. First check whether evidence for define core and build-up actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: The core supports mechanics and through-connections; outer build-up handles fine routing.
steps.check: 交付「定義核心與增層」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for define core and build-up, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.
